name: Virtual patients (PBPK dosing)
summary: A whole-body pharmacokinetic model of twenty drugs in virtual patients: trials, the best dose per population, a live bedside, and an anaesthesia room where a case is run and scored
help: Twenty drugs. Twelve for dosing: theophylline, midazolam, digoxin, morphine, naloxone, flumazenil, propranolol, atropine, ondansetron, paracetamol, amlodipine, salbutamol. Eight more for anaesthesia: propofol, remifentanil, fentanyl, rocuronium, sugammadex, neostigmine, phenylephrine, ephedrine. Run a virtual trial: a population on a regimen; who ends up in the target range, below it, above it, and who reaches toxic levels, overall and by group. Find the dose: for every population, the dose that puts the most patients in range while keeping toxic levels rare. Bedside (live): one patient (fourteen profiles) dosed from the 3D view's controls; any number of drugs at once, each with its own whole-body model, their effects combining on the vitals (antidotes reverse, beta-blockers blunt, side effects add up), the organs coloured by how much of the chosen drug they hold, a healthy adult on the same doses for comparison. Anaesthesia (live): the same patient, but with a job to do — a four-hour operation, a day of intensive-care sedation with the wake-up test, or a therapeutic coma. Send them to sleep, relax them, take over the breathing, hold the depth while the surgeon works, then reverse it and wake them up; the room scores the time at the right depth, the blood pressure held, the oxygen and the steps done in order. Make the 3D models: the patient (from a labelled CT case, or a mockup) and the scene. Concentrations are in each drug's unit (mg/L for theophylline, paracetamol, propofol and rocuronium, ng/mL for the others).

inputs.label: CT case
inputs.help: Make the 3D models: a CT case with its labels (ct.nii.gz and segmentations/<structure>.nii.gz, as the TotalSegmentator dataset gives them). Without it, the CT case setting, else a mockup body.

outputs.label: Course
outputs.help: course.csv: the plasma concentration over time, percentiles over the patients (p05, p25, median, p75, p95), with the target range and the toxic level

outputs.label: Patients
outputs.help: patients.csv: one row per virtual patient (who they are, clearance, half-life, trough, peak, average, outcome)

outputs.label: By group
outputs.help: groups.csv: in range, below, above and toxic peaks for each group (smokers, age bands, sex, conditions)

outputs.label: Doses tried
outputs.help: Find the dose: dose_finding.csv, every dose tried for every population

outputs.label: Best doses
outputs.help: Find the dose: best_doses.csv, the dose chosen for each population

outputs.label: 3D models
outputs.help: Make the 3D models: patient.glb and patient.scene.json, for the project's assets

params.label: Dose
params.help: mg (or mg/kg) per dose: theophylline 300, midazolam 2-5, digoxin 0.125-0.25, morphine 4-10, propranolol 40, paracetamol 1000, amlodipine 5-10...

params.label: Extra with the first dose
params.help: A loading dose, in the same unit as the dose

params.label: Target range (theophylline)
params.help: Theophylline only; the other drugs use their own range (midazolam sedation 70-260 ng/mL, digoxin 0.5-2 ng/mL, morphine 20-80 ng/mL...)

params.label: Find the dose: toxic levels at most (%)
Bedside: first patient
params.help: The 3D view's Patient control changes it while it runs

params.label: Anaesthesia: the job
options: Intensive care: sedation and the wake-up test
params.help: The 3D view's Job control changes it while it runs. The operation: asleep, relaxed, intubated, four hours held, reversed, awake, tube out. Intensive care: light sedation for eight hours, then the daily wake-up test. Therapeutic coma: burst suppression for twenty-four hours, then back up.

params.label: Anaesthesia: the patient
params.help: The 3D view's Patient control changes it while it runs

params.label: Anaesthesia: minutes it stays open
params.help: Real minutes. The room's Clock control runs the patient's time at up to an hour a second, so a four-hour case fits in a few minutes.

params.label: Make the 3D models: CT case
params.help: With nothing wired to CT case: a case of the TotalSegmentator dataset (such as s1400), read in place from Zenodo. Empty: the mockup body.
